title: General.
officialText:
This appendix addresses natural gas distribution piping requirements for systems where
the gas pressure is at or above 15 psig (103 kPa gauge). Installations of gas piping at pressures at or
above 15 psig (103 kPa gauge) and equipment and appliances using gas with an inlet pressure at or
above 15 psig (103 kPa gauge) shall be considered as high pressure natural gas installations.
